destination_profile.context: Much sought out for its ‘chilled out’ atmosphere, Unawatuna is a beautiful palm fringed cove on the Southern coastline, close to Galle. If you love a beach party atmosphere, this is the place to be. With plenty of restaurants and bars, ‘Una’ is buzzing with sun, fun, music and life all year round, and the best time to visit Unawatuna is in fact, any time. If you want a break, the protected Galapiteala and Napoleon Reefs over the bay offer safe swimming, and there are plenty of other natural and cultural attractions too.
